information:
Registration info
* Registration opens on Monday, 12th February, 12:00am (GMT+8).
* The steps for registration are as follows:
1. [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/USMPenangCube2018/register) 
2. [Pay](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-usmpenangcube2018) according the events you registered.
3. [Email us](mailto:mycubeassociation@gmail.com) the receipt with:
        i) First Timer - Photocopy of NRIC/Passport with name, nationality and DOB.
        ii) Returner - WCA ID, with name.
4. Once we have verify your details confirm the correct payment, we will accept your registration.

**Kindly check the [payment page](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-usmpenangcube2018) for the payment method. Payment which does not match with the event registered will be recognise as 'Incomplete registration'**
